import hashlib,json,statistics
from pathlib import Path
out=Path(__file__).parent
def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
identity=json.loads((out/'identity.json').read_text())
runs=json.loads((out/'runs.json').read_text())
assert len(runs)==4 and all(r['returncode']==0 for r in runs)
cells=[]
phases=['aggregate','ordered','savepoint','prepared','constraints']
for run in runs:
    folder=Path(run['output']);results=json.loads((folder/'results.json').read_text())
    assert len(results)==(2 if run['profile'] else 8)
    sid=json.loads((folder/'identity.json').read_text())
    assert sid['source_sha']==identity['source']
    for result in results:
        assert result['status']=='passed' and result['exit_code']==0 and result['fixture_removed']
        events=[json.loads(l) for l in (folder/(result['case']+'.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
        stderr=(folder/(result['case']+'.stderr')).read_text()
        ready=[e for e in events if e['event']=='ready'];complete=[e for e in events if e['event']=='complete']
        assert len(ready)==len(complete)==1
        r,c=ready[0],complete[0];n=r['rows'];engine,lane=r['operation'].split('-')
        expected_stderr=(f"Sampling process {r['pid']} for 3 seconds with 1 millisecond of run time between samples\n"
                         "Sampling completed, processing symbols...\n"
                         f"Sample analysis of process {r['pid']} written to file {folder}/{result['case']}.sample.txt\n")
        assert stderr==(expected_stderr if run['profile'] else '')
        fixture=[(i,float(i),i%2==0) for i in range(n)]
        assert r['input_sha256']==digest(fixture)
        assert r['result_sha256']==c['result_sha256']==digest({'bench':fixture,'auxiliary':[]})
        assert c['final_rows']==n and c['connection_closed'] and c['process_peak_rss_bytes']<2**31
        assert r['driver_sha256']==identity['harness']['sqlite_composite_profile.py']['sha256']
        assert r['original_sha256']==identity['harness']['workloads/sqlite_composite_v0816.py']['sha256']
        assert set(r['thread_environment'].values())=={'1'}
        if engine=='alopex':
            assert r['native']=={'alopex':identity['package']['_alopex.abi3.so']['sha256']}
        else:
            assert r['native']=={'pysqlite3':identity['reference']['pysqlite3/_sqlite3.cpython-313-darwin.so']['sha256']}
            assert r['settings']['version']=='3.46.1' and r['settings']['initial_foreign_keys']==0
            assert r['settings']['foreign_keys']==int(lane=='checked') and r['settings']['isolation_level'] is None
        for event,count in [('plan_sample',24),('sample',0 if run['profile'] else 24),('phase_sample',24 if lane=='checked' and not run['profile'] else 0)]:
            samples=[e for e in events if e['event']==event]
            assert len(samples)==count and sum(e['phase']=='measure' for e in samples)==(21 if count else 0)
            for e in samples:
                if event=='phase_sample': assert list(e['intervals_ns'])==phases and all(t>0 for t in e['intervals_ns'].values())
                else: assert e['total_ns']>0
        if not run['profile']: assert c['iterations']==24
        cell=dict(trial=run['trial'],profile=run['profile'],case=result['case'],ready=r,complete=c,result=result,events=events)
        if run['profile']:
            cell['python_profile']=(folder/(result['case']+'.client.profile.txt')).read_text()
            cell['native_profile']=(folder/(result['case']+'.sample.txt')).read_text()
            assert 'Call graph:' in cell['native_profile']

    measured=[e for c in group for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='sample' and e['phase']=='measure']
    center=statistics.median(e['total_ns'] for e in measured)
    phase_times={name:[statistics.median(e['intervals_ns'][name] for e in c['events'] if e['event']=='phase_sample' and e['phase']=='measure')/1e6 for c in group] for name in phases} if case.endswith('checked') else {}
